label: The Flooded Entrance
hint: One of you primes, the other finishes: Glacial Spire then Shield Rush, or Lance of Dawn then Arc Lance.

label: The Drowned Chapel
hint: Water freezes, oil burns, lightning runs through whole pools. Break barrels to make your own.

label: The Sluice Gates
hint: Stand on both sluice plates together to open the gate. Either of you can take either plate.

label: The Belfry
hint: The Bellkeeper tolls its bell. While it stands beside the bell, shove or rush it into the bell to Stagger it.

label: The Rune Shrine
hint: Take the rune at the shrine and try it on the dummies before the Abbess.

label: The Abbess's Basin
hint: Floods hide her anchors: turn a sluice wheel or freeze the water, break the anchors, then strike while she is Staggered.
